title: PasskeysAnswer
description: The answer of GET /api/site/passkeys for a site session (ADR 0002, sections 4 and 11): the signed-in account's own passkeys, the oldest first, and whether its kind may add one. `can_add` is false while the account's kind is closed to adding passkeys, which today is every kind (ADR 0010, section 7); adding is then refused with 403 `passkeys_closed`. `can_add` true promises no addition: adding still needs a recent sign-in and is still refused at 10 passkeys or over the limit of starts. Of a passkey the site is told its id, its name and its dates, never its credential id or its key. No other field is allowed.

items.title: Passkey
items.description: One passkey as the site is shown it: its id, its name (1 to 40 characters, always rendered as text), when it was added and when it last signed in (null when it never has).
